metadata.title: fix: reduce idle transactions in admin/aggregation
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary
This PR fixes the performance regression under load by tightening DB session lifecycle and reconciling missing indexes on freshly bootstrapped databases.

## Key changes
- Bootstrap/migrations: ensure empty DBs get migration-only indexes by stamping the previous head and running `alembic upgrade head`; add a reconciliation migration that creates any missing indexes (skips `idx_a2a_agents_tags` because Postgres can’t B-tree JSON).
- Session lifecycle: release transactions before async I/O across resource/tool/server/prompt/team/gateway services; commit after heavy log/tag query fetches before Python-side aggregation; avoid shadowing the injected DB session in admin observability endpoints (with a safe fallback for direct test calls).
- Config/docs/deploy: document and wire `PERMISSION_AUDIT_ENABLED` (default `false`) in config, `.env.example`, helm values/schema, docker-compose, and the configuration docs.
- Tests: update migration/observability/unit tests to reflect the bootstrap + session behavior changes.

## Why
Fresh DBs created via `create_all()` were missing migration-defined indexes, and several hot paths held transactions open during async work or Python loops. Both issues led to idle-in-transaction connections and throughput drops under load.

## Testing
- make doctest
- make test
- make flake8
- make pylint

Closes #2660

commits.message:
fix(perf): release DB transactions before async I/O in service layer

- Remove db.refresh() after commit in all CRUD services to prevent
  implicit transactions held open during cache invalidation and
  notification async I/O
- Convert ORM objects to read models before commit so no lazy loads
  occur after transaction release
- Change audit_trail db=db to db=None to avoid session references
  during structured logging
- Use fresh_db_session() in RBAC permission decorators instead of
  reusing the request session
- Cache team member count before commit in team creation
- Add _member_count_cached support to EmailTeam.get_member_count()

Closes #2660

commits.message:
fix(perf): revert double-session and double-commit patterns in routes

Remove explicit db.commit()/db.close() calls from route handlers and
admin endpoints — get_db() dependency already handles session cleanup.
Revert RBAC middleware from always using fresh_db_session() back to
preferring the existing request session with fresh fallback. These
patterns doubled DB sessions per request and caused RPS to drop from
~2000 to ~1200.

Preserves service layer flush/commit pattern and db=None audit trail.

commits.message:
fix(perf): QueuePool, index ordering, bootstrap indexes, streaming DB leak

- Switch docker-compose from NullPool to QueuePool with pre_ping to
  eliminate per-request TCP + SCRAM-SHA-256 connection overhead that was
  holding the GIL and halving throughput
- Increase PgBouncer CPU limits (2→4 cores) to handle higher TPS
- Fix _index_exists_on_columns to compare column lists in order rather
  than as sets, since B-tree index column order matters for query planning
- Add _ensure_performance_indexes to bootstrap_db so migration-only
  indexes are created regardless of migration path
- Pass shared DB session in token_scoping middleware to avoid extra
  session creation on public-only token paths
- Release DB connection before long-lived streaming in llm_proxy_service
  to prevent session leaks during SSE responses

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(perf): reduce PgBouncer overhead - RESET ALL, disable pre_ping

- Change server_reset_query from DISCARD ALL to RESET ALL, eliminating
  ~3000 heavy reset statements/sec. DISCARD ALL resets prepared
  statements, temp tables, and search paths unnecessarily since
  SQLAlchemy manages client-side state. RESET ALL only resets GUCs.
- Disable pool_pre_ping (DB_POOL_PRE_PING=false) since each SELECT 1
  counts as a separate PgBouncer transaction in transaction mode,
  adding ~1 extra transaction per HTTP request. With pool_recycle=120,
  stale connections are handled by age-based recycling instead.
- Increase CLIENT_IDLE_TIMEOUT from 60s to 300s to prevent PgBouncer
  from killing QueuePool connections that sit idle between requests.
- Increase DB_POOL_RECYCLE from 60s to 120s (must be < CLIENT_IDLE_TIMEOUT).

Measured impact (4000 concurrent users):
- PgBouncer CPU: 97% -> 52% (no longer the bottleneck)
- PgBouncer TPS: 3317 -> 2175 (-34%)
- Transactions per HTTP request: 4.1 -> 2.3
- avg_query_time: 4.3ms -> 2.3ms (-46%)
- Error rate: 0.34% -> 0.23%

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>

commits.message:
fix: restore DISCARD ALL for PgBouncer, add client disconnect middleware

- Revert SERVER_RESET_QUERY from RESET ALL back to DISCARD ALL;
  RESET ALL does not release session-level advisory locks, causing
  bootstrap deadlocks when multiple gateway replicas start concurrently.
- Increase IDLE_TRANSACTION_TIMEOUT to 60s and re-enable DB_POOL_PRE_PING.
- Add ClientDisconnectMiddleware that cancels in-flight request handlers
  when the client (nginx) closes the connection, preventing CLOSE_WAIT
  accumulation and memory leaks under sustained load.
- Add utf-8 coding headers to unified_pdp plugin files.

commits.message:
fix: tune PgBouncer idle_transaction_timeout and remove redundant db commit/close

- Increase IDLE_TRANSACTION_TIMEOUT from 60s to 120s (safety net for
  sessions idle within a transaction, not a traffic cop)
- Remove redundant db.commit()/db.close() in read_resource route handler
  (invoke_resource already commits+closes for gateway path, get_db()
  handles cleanup for all paths via its finally block)

Closes #2660

commits.message:
fix: eliminate redundant DB queries in read_resource and invoke_resource

Steps 3-4 of load test RCA: reduce per-request query count from 6 to 2
for resource-by-ID requests.

Step 3: After Q2 (db.get), check enabled in Python and guard Q3/Q4 with
resource_db is None so they only run for URI-only lookups.

Step 4: Add joinedload(DbResource.gateway) to Q2, pass pre-fetched
resource_obj and gateway_obj to invoke_resource() to skip Q5/Q6.

commits.message:
fix: resolve load test regressions and parallel test segfaults (RCA steps 5-9)

- Fix isinstance(user, dict) bug: ORM EmailUser objects always evaluated
  as non-admin, causing 73.6% failure rate on /resources/[id] under load
- Add shutdown_instrumentation() to stop background span writer before
  engine disposal, preventing race condition segfaults in parallel tests
- Skip middleware DB check for resource endpoints (defer to service layer)
  to eliminate redundant sessions on the hot path
- Use contains_eager + roles cache in permission_service to avoid N+1
  queries and duplicate DB round-trips during audit logging
- Use asyncio.gather for concurrent cache invalidation in team creation
- Refactor healthcheck to use engine.connect() instead of SessionLocal
- Use ExitStack for 19 context managers to avoid CPython 3.12 compiler segfault
- Tune PostgreSQL timeouts: statement_timeout=60s, idle_in_transaction=180s
- Revert QUERY_WAIT_TIMEOUT to 60s baseline
- Fix test_tool_service cache poisoning by mocking registry cache
